b.x: The order of dying, roughly, is this: three minutes without air, three hours without shelter in the extreme, three days without water, three weeks without food. The bag obeys that order, not the internet list. The list to tick is in Kits. The house first-aid box is larger. Here only what the hand uses on the stairs goes in.

The building says to come down. The flood rises. The power does not return and the market does not open. You walk to someone’s house, or you wait three days in a shelter, or you stay in the car until morning. It is not an escape into the woods. It is not a move. If the bag does not pass the turnstile at work without embarrassment, it is not a 72-hour bag. It is a stage. One stays near the door at home. If the car is plan B, a smaller one in the trunk: water, light, a blanket, a triangle, a charger. In the heat, the car water gets changed. Do not leave a bottle in the sun all year.

Two to three liters in the bag, per person who walks. One liter weighs one kilo. Three liters are already three kilos before the food. That is why the bag does not carry the week: it carries the day and a way to make more. A filter you have already used at home, tablets, or the boil plan, the same one as the water tab, rehearsed, not read in the hour. A bottle that closes. Not dozens of open little bottles. If there is a child, an older person, or hard heat, three liters is the floor, not the ceiling. Without a way to treat more water, the bottle ends on the second day and the bag lied.
Food that does not ask for fire

Three days of what the mouth already accepts with no stove. A bar, nuts, a biscuit the house eats on Tuesday, a can with the opener inside the bag, not in the kitchen drawer. Oral rehydration if the family doctor already advised it, especially in heat and diarrhea. It is not a feast. It is not a ration with an operator’s name that nobody tastes. If the child does not eat it on Sunday, they will not eat it “on the day”. A sugar or pocket glucose, only for someone awake who swallows. Food that needs water to work counts as water too. Write that into the weight.

A rain poncho that fits in the fist. A blanket or a compact bag. One pair of dry socks, the item the internet forgets and the foot charges for. One set of clothes from the street you are on, not a uniform. A hat if the sun is the problem. In the southern cold, one more layer. In the heat, the poncho still goes in: Brazilian rain wets the document and the gauze. A dry bag for the paper and the phone. Trash and minimal hygiene: soap, paper, a pad. Disease arrives before hunger if the hand does not wash.

A hand torch and a spare cell. The phone is map and message, not the only light. A charged power bank and a short cable. A small battery radio, for when the tower goes quiet. A whistle. Tape. A paper map of the city and of the route to the point. Document copies, not the only original if you can avoid it. Small cash. A contact list on paper: the meeting point, the deadline, one phone outside the city. One sentence. No app. A compass only if you already know how to use it. An offline app only if it was tested in airplane mode.
The aid that fits the bag

Not the whole house box. Gloves. Gauze. Tape. One bandage. The painkiller you already use. The 72 hours of medicine for whoever has pressure, diabetes, a child, an allergy, with the dose written. Epinephrine and an inhaler only if they were prescribed. A thermometer, if it fits. A notebook and a pencil. Sugar only for someone awake who swallows. A card with 192, 193, 190, valid in Brazil. Outside the country, the local number, written before. A tourniquet does not go in this bag if nobody trained. The full gesture is in the lesson and on the red tab. The bag only carries the cloth.
Whoever comes along changes the bag

A child: one extra day of what they will not give up, clothes in today’s size, the medicine with the dose, a copy of the document. An older person: the pressure tablet and what the leg can carry. It is not the same load. Whoever cannot chew the dry food needs other food. An animal: water, a little food, the leash, if it comes. If it does not, the plan of who stays with it is on paper, not in hope. Each person who walks has their own water. One bag for four bodies becomes a move and stops on the first flight.

Put it on. Climb three flights. Walk to the corner and back. If the shoulder hurts, something left: the second tool, the can nobody eats, the costume coat. The bag stays at the door, not at the back of the bedroom. Once a season: expiry, cells, the child’s clothing size, the climate. Once a month in the heat: the water. Whoever lives with you finds the bag with eyes closed and knows the sentence of the point. No photo. No audience. No arguing about what to take when the stairs are already wet.
